name: atready
description: Bring AtReady a goal or rough plan before implementation and see where your saved resources fit.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with what's at the ready
interface.longDescription: AtReady is a small planning companion for supported Codex surfaces. Bring it a goal, rough plan, or written plan before implementation. It visibly shapes the minimum useful workstreams, suggests where your saved tools, services, subscriptions, and agents fit, explains its choices, and prepares handoffs for review without contacting or running routed project resources. This local-first release requires a separately installed compatible project-atready runtime and local file access.
defaultPrompt: I have a rough project idea. Use AtReady before implementation to suggest where my saved resources fit.
Review this plan with AtReady and show proposed resource assignments.
Add CodeRabbit to my AtReady resource roster.
